## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Claim Boundary

- [ ] This PR does not over-claim beyond the evidence included.
- [ ] If this PR contains experiment results, the denominator, seeds, controls, and invalid runs are explicit.
- [ ] If this PR is clean-only, it does not claim attack, VIS, RAND, Teacher timing, or closed-loop effects.

## Artifact Policy

- [ ] Large generated ledgers, videos, tensors, model files, and raw output snapshots are not committed.
- [ ] Regenerable audit outputs are either excluded or summarized compactly.
- [ ] Any external artifact bundle has a path, SHA256, and reproduction command.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Reviewer Notes

Call out expected failures, known gaps, or follow-up gates.
